name: Bad Gas
description_en: Isaac farts and poisons nearby enemies
description_zh: 角色放屁并使附近敌人中毒

name: Bad Trip
description_en:
Deals 1 heart of damage to Isaac
Becomes a Full Health pill at 1 heart or less
description_zh:
对角色造成1心伤害
不多于1心时, 变为体力回满胶囊

name: Balls of Steel
description_en: +2 Soul Hearts
description_zh: +2魂心

name: Bombs are Key
description_en:
Swaps Isaac's number of bombs and keys
Golden bombs and keys are also swapped
description_zh:
交换角色持有的炸弹和钥匙的数量
金炸弹和金钥匙也会交换

name: Explosive Diarrhea
description_en: Isaac quickly spawns 5 lit bombs
description_zh: 在角色位置快速生成5个激活的炸弹

name: Full Health
description_en: Fully heals all heart containers
description_zh: 回满血

name: Health Down
description_en:
-1 Health
Becomes a Health Up pill at 0 or 1 heart containers
description_zh:
-1心之容器
不多于1心之容器时, 变为体力上升胶囊

name: Health Up
description_en: +1 Empty heart container
description_zh: +1空心之容器

name: I Found Pills
description_en: No effect
description_zh: 无效果

name: Puberty
description_en:
No effect
Eating 3 grants the Adult transformation:
 +1 Health
description_zh:
无效果
吃3个会获得成人套装:
 +1心之容器

name: Pretty Fly
description_en: +1 Fly orbital
description_zh: +1苍蝇环绕物

name: Range Down
description_en: -1 Range
description_zh: 射程-1

name: Range Up
description_en: +1.25 Range

name: Speed Down
description_en: -0.12 Speed

name: Speed Up
description_en: +0.15 Speed

name: Tears Down
description_en: -0.28 Tears

name: Tears Up
description_en: +0.35 Tears

name: Luck Down
description_en: -1 Luck
description_zh: 幸运-1

name: Luck Up
description_en: +1 Luck
description_zh: 幸运+1

name: Telepills
description_en:
Teleports Isaac to a random room
 Small chance to teleport Isaac to the I AM ERROR room
description_zh:
将角色传送至随机房间
 小概率传送至错误房

name: 48 Hour Energy!
description_en:
Fully recharges the active item
 Spawns 1-2 batteries
description_zh:
将主动道具完全充能
 生成1-2电池

name: Hematemesis
description_en:
Drains all but one heart container
 Spawns 1-4 Red Hearts
description_zh:
清空红心但保留1红心
 生成1-4红心

name: Paralysis
description_en: Prevents Isaac from moving and shooting for 2 seconds
description_zh: 角色不能移动和发射2秒

name: I can see forever!
description_en: Opens all secret room entrances on the floor
description_zh: 打开本层所有隐藏房的入口

name: Pheromones
description_en: Charms all enemies in the room
description_zh: 魅惑房间中所有敌人

name: Amnesia
description_en: Hides the map for the floor
description_zh: 隐藏本层地图

name: Lemon Party
description_en: Spawns a large puddle on the ground which damages enemies
description_zh: 生成一大滩水迹, 对敌人造成伤害

name: R U A Wizard?
description_en: Isaac shoots diagonally for 30 seconds
description_zh: 角色进行对角发射30秒

name: Percs!
description_en: Reduces all damage taken to half a heart for the room
description_zh: 当前房间中受到的伤害均为半心

name: Addicted!
description_en: Increases all damage taken to a full heart for the room
description_zh: 当前房间中受到的伤害均为整心

name: Re-Lax
description_en: Isaac spawns poop behind him for 2 seconds
description_zh: 2秒内, 角色在身后生成大便

description_en: Curse of the Maze effect for the floor
description_zh: 本层施加混乱诅咒的效果

name: One makes you larger
description_en:
Increases Isaac's size
Doesn't affect his hitbox
description_zh:
角色体型变大
不影响碰撞箱

name: One makes you small
description_en:
Decreases Isaac's size
Also decreases his hitbox
description_zh:
角色体型变小
也会使碰撞箱变小

name: Infested!
description_en: Spawns 1 blue spider for each poop in the room
description_zh: 房间中每1个大便生成1只蓝蜘蛛

name: Infested?
description_en:
Spawn 1 blue spider for each enemy in the room
Spawns 1-3 blue spiders if there are no enemies in the room
description_zh:
房间中每有1个敌人生成1只蓝蜘蛛
若房间中没有敌人则生成1-3只蓝蜘蛛

name: Power Pill!
description_en:
Receive for 6.5 seconds:
Invincibility
Isaac can't shoot but deals 40 contact damage per second
 Killing 2 enemies heals half a heart
 Fears all enemies in the room
description_zh:
在6.5秒内获得:
无敌
角色无法发射, 但每秒造成40点接触伤害
 每击杀2个敌人治疗半红心
 使房间中的所有敌人恐惧

name: Retro Vision
description_en: Pixelates the screen for 30 seconds
description_zh: 屏幕像素化30秒

name: Friends Till The End!
description_en: Spawns 3 blue flies
description_zh: 生成3只蓝苍蝇

name: X-Lax
description_en: Spawns a pool of slippery creep
description_zh: 生成一摊打滑水迹

name: Something's wrong...
description_en: Spawns a pool of slowing creep
description_zh: 生成一摊减速水迹

name: I'm Drowsy...
description_en: Slows Isaac and all enemies in the room
description_zh: 使房间中所有敌人和角色减速

name: I'm Excited!!
description_en:
Speeds up Isaac and all enemies in the room
Triggers again after 30 and 60 seconds
description_zh:
使房间中所有敌人和角色加速
在30秒以及60秒后再触发一次

name: Gulp!
description_en: Consumes Isaac's trinket and grants its effects permanently
description_zh: 消耗角色的饰品并永久获得其效果

name: Horf!
description_en: Shoots one Ipecac tear
description_zh: 发射1颗吐根酊泪弹

name: Feels like I'm walking on sunshine!
description_en:
Receive for 6 seconds:
Invincibility
Isaac can't shoot (No contact damage)
description_zh:
在6秒内获得:
 移速+0.28
无敌
角色无法发射(也没有接触伤害)

name: Vurp!
description_en: Spawns the last pill used before Vurp!
description_zh: 生成上次使用的胶囊

name: Shot speed Down
description_en: -0.15 Shot speed

name: Shot speed Up
description_en: +0.15 Shot speed

name: Experimental Pill
description_en:
Increases 1 random stat
Decreases 1 random stat
description_zh:
随机提升1项属性
随机降低1项属性
